text: dsh-history-edit 为 DSH 网页聊天加入对话历史编辑操作。用户可以修改自己发过的消息并重新生成回答，在较早的 AI 回复处回退后继续对话，也可以把 AI 回复改写到一份会话副本中。客户端在聊天消息旁提供操作入口、编辑窗口和回退提示；主机端读取会话历史并处理这些请求。适合需要修正提问、重走对话分支或调整回复文本的 DSH 网页端用户。无需 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-history-edit adds history editing to DSH web chat. Users can revise a message and regenerate its answer, continue from an earlier reply, or edit an AI reply in a conversation copy. The page provides chat controls and a rewind notice. No API key or external account is required.
我想改掉之前发给 DSH 的问题，然后重新生成回答。
能不能回到较早的一轮对话，从那里继续聊？
Can I revise an earlier prompt and have the assistant answer it again?
dsh-history-edit 的功能「编辑对话历史」：在聊天消息旁提供编辑与回退操作。修改自己的消息后会重新生成回答；回到较早回复后，下一条消息会从该处继续；修改 AI 回复则会在会话副本中进行。

dsh-history-edit README · dsh-history-edit：Conversation history edits for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/AI-Scarlett/DSH-Store) (DSH):
change what you said, go back to an earlier point, or fix an AI reply, without losing anything.

> **Maintenance: best-effort.** Issues may go unanswered; forks are welcome.

dsh-history-edit README · What it adds to the chat：- **Recall** (under each of your messages). Goes back to just before that message and puts its
  text back in the message box, to resend as is, changed, or with files. Nothing is deleted: when
  you send the next message, the recalled message and everything after it are set aside.
- **Edit again** (on a message that was edited through the `rewrite` method of the channel below).
  Opens an edit window; the edited message replaces the old one and the AI answers again. If later
  messages of yours exist, a **copy** of the conversation is created instead, so nothing is lost,
  and the page opens it.
- **Go back here** (under an AI reply that has later turns). The next message you send restarts
  from that reply and the later turns are set aside. A banner says so and has a **Cancel** button.
- **Edit reply** (under an AI reply). Creates a copy of the conversation up to that turn with the
  reply text changed; the original stays as it was, and the page opens the copy.

dsh-history-edit README · What it adds to the chat："Set aside" means hidden from the AI and from the chat page. The events stay in the session log.

The interface is in English, and in French when the page language is French. To add a language,
add a table to `STRINGS` at the top of `client.js` (missing keys fall back to English).

text:
dsh-history-edit README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MathieuPortmann/dsh-history-edit
```

Restart the profile afterwards. Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24` and DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`
(see [Compatibility](#compatibility)). Once the package is on npm, `dsh plugin --profile web add
dsh-history-edit` works too.

The plugin has no configuration.

dsh-history-edit README · How it works：- The DSH session log is append-only. A message can carry `surfaceOp: replace {startSeq, endSeq}`:
  it takes the place of that range of events in what the model sees (the "surface"). Editing and
  going back both write one such message; nothing is ever removed from the log.
- `lib/history.js` holds the reasoning over the log as pure functions (which turn a message is in,
  which range an edit or a go-back replaces, whether a reply can be edited, how an edited reply
  event looks). It has no dependency and is covered by `tests/`.
- `index.js` (host side) reads the session through DSH, calls `lib/history.js`, and writes the
  result. It serves a small JSON channel at `/dsh-history/<method>` (`list`, `rewrite`, `rewind`,
  `cancelRewind`, `editReply`, `canEdit`), protected by DSH's own connection check (Host/Origin
  fence and browser token).
- `client.js` (page side) draws the buttons, the edit window and the banner, and hides the turns
  that were set aside. It finds the chat rows through the `data-chat-flow-kind`,
  `data-chat-anchor-key` and `data-chat-turn` attributes of DSH's chat page.

dsh-history-edit README · Compatibility：| Component | Supported |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` (`engines.node`) |
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`; declared as optional `peerDependencies` on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, the only DSH packages the host side imports |
| Platform | Linux (tested); pure JavaScript, no native addon |
| Page | the chat page of DSH's web UI; the buttons depend on its row attributes and may need an update when the page changes |
dsh-history-edit README · Compatibility：Tested with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` on Node 22.23 (see [Verification](#verification)).

dsh-history-edit README · Permissions and external services：| Capability | Where | Used for | If it fails |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Files** | `index.js` (`realpathSync`) | resolves the path of the running `dsh` binary, to find DSH's own packages; the plugin reads and writes no other file itself | the plugin fails to load |
| **Session log** | `index.js` (through `ctx.agents`, `ctx.sessionController`) | reads the events of a conversation; appends the edited message, and creates a copy of the conversation (new session) for an edit in a copy or an edited reply. This is the plugin's purpose | the operation returns an error code and the page shows a message; the original conversation is not touched |
| **Network** | none | nothing leaves the computer | n/a |
| **Commands** | none | no child process, no shell | n/a |
| **HTTP route** | `index.js` (`ctx.webServer.register`) | `POST /dsh-history/<method>` for the page, behind `ctx.connection.admit()` (DSH's Host/Origin fence and token); bodies are limited to 1 MiB and must be JSON | non-admitted requests get 401/403; other errors are returned as JSON |
| **Dynamic module loading** | `index.js` (`importFromDsh`) | loads `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`
dsh-history-edit README · Permissions and external services：The plugin adds no tool for the model and no setting.

dsh-history-edit README · Verification：Checked on a disposable profile (`DSH_HOME` pointing at a temporary folder, profile cloned with
`dsh <name> --from-default-profile web`, so the real profile is never touched):

```sh
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile t add file:$PWD/dsh-history-edit-0.1.0.tgz   # install
dsh --profile t --no-open --port 3095                              # start: plugin loads, no error
dsh plugin --profile t remove dsh-history-edit                      # uninstall

dsh-history-edit README · Verification：`npm test` runs 24 standalone tests of `lib/history.js` (turn outline, edit plans, go-back ranges,
reply cuts, edited replies, contiguity errors) with no DSH installation needed. The module is a
JavaScript port of the logic that first ran in a native addon; the port was compared with that
addon on about 2.2 million generated and real-log cases with identical results.
